stories.title: Nine-bedroom holiday let approved for barns at Rhydymwyn farm
stories.summary: Redundant barns at a farm near Mold have been approved for conversion into a nine-bedroom holiday let. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee approved the application for Tyddyn Y Gwynt Farm, Rhydymwyn, on 11 September. The application was submitted by agents Paterson Macaulay & Owens Ltd. stories.title: Wales has worst child obesity rate in the UK, new report reveals
stories.summary: Children’s health in Wales is declining across most key indicators, according to a new report from the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health. stories.title: Engine idling fines set to rise sevenfold in Wales this month
stories.summary: Fines for leaving a car engine running while stationary are set to rise sharply in Wales from this month. The Road Traffic (Vehicle Emissions) (Fixed Penalty) (Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 come into force on 30 September. stories.title: Mayor of Mold to raise funds for good causes at food festival
stories.summary: Mold Town Council will have a presence at this year’s Mold Food and Drink Festival, running from 18 to 20 September. Representatives will be at the Totally Mold marquee throughout Saturday and Sunday to meet residents and visitors. stories.title: Free childcare for eligible two-year-olds in Flintshire from November
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has opened applications for funded childcare places for two-year-olds living in eligible areas of the county. Applications opened on 1 September, with places available from 2 November. The scheme is run through the Welsh Government’s Flying Start programme.
